why: An issue outside the expected ledger is not automatically noise. The ledger (issue #166) records only defects the 60-case classification supported, so a finding it does not list can still be grounded in the pair's NL. Mixing the two kinds understates precision when a grounded extra is counted as a false positive, and overstates it when a fabricated one is waved through as 'extra insight'. Each entry below was adjudicated against the model text and the NL, with the deciding evidence recorded so a reader can re-derive the call rather than trust the label.
how_to_use: After a matrix run, cross-check its published issues against `fabricated` below. A fabricated entry that reappears means the underlying predicate defect is unfixed; one that disappears is the fix landing. `grounded` entries are expected to persist and must not be counted as false positives.

fabricated.title: 自治运行返回条件组事件后未进入 HumanDrivingMode
fabricated.why_fabricated: The obligation holds in the model. `occupancy_after` answers True when pinned at AutonomousMode.FinalWaittr_0005, firing the token route transition:0/transition:15. It answers False from every position an eventless completion edge leaves -- SubState1/2/3 and the composite -- firing only transitions 6/7/8, which are the eventless edges. Raising within_cycles does not help: False at 1..9.
fabricated.secondary_cause: within_cycles=2 stopped the simulation at SubState3, one step short of the converter-owned FinalWaittr_0005, so attribution saw no exclusion and marked the binding safe. 0050-claude bound the same requirement, reached FinalWaittr_0005, and was correctly filed as representation_debt -- the same wrong False, filtered only because its horizon was larger.

fabricated.title: HighwayMode 的初始子状态不是 enter_hwy
fabricated.why_fabricated: The converter gives HighwayMode a synthetic unconditional default entry `[*] -> UnspecifiedInitial` alongside the authored `[*] -> enter_hwy : if [R45RouteToken == 5]`. UnspecifiedInitial is listed in the pair's attribution_exclusions, so a False resting on it is representation debt by policy. initial_target(HighwayMode, enter_hwy) is False and initial_target(HighwayMode, UnspecifiedInitial) is True, yet the failing call's model_refs name only HighwayMode and enter_hwy -- attribution has no exclusion to match and marks it safe.

fabricated.title: UrbanMode 的初始子状态不是 enter_urban
fabricated.why_fabricated: Same shape as REQ-006 on the sibling composite: `[*] -> enter_urban : if [R45RouteToken == 12]` plus synthetic `[*] -> UnspecifiedInitial`, the latter excluded from attribution and absent from the failing call's refs.

titles: AutoNavigating 中 Power_Off 未进入 FinalState
AutoFinal 中 Power_Off 未进入 FinalState
grounded.why_grounded: Further instances of the ledger's own EXP-0000-IT-001. The model's only Power_Off edge leaves the pseudo-initial, so no running state has a Power_Off exit at all -- these name two more states the same defect reaches. The ledger lists one instance because the criterion needs one, not because the others are wrong.

titles: UAVSwarmStateMachine 的直接子状态数量不等于三
grounded.why_grounded: The NL says the swarm 'operates within three different state areas'; UAVSwarmStateMachine declares four direct substates (FormationAdjustment, Attack, Searching, Intercepted). The root-level UnspecifiedInitial is outside the composite and does not affect the count, so the mismatch is in the authored model.

titles: 缺少任务完成状态，持续搜索释放条件无法声明
UAVSwarmStateMachine 未直接包含正好三个非伪状态区域
grounded.why_grounded: REQ-002 is the same four-versus-three mismatch 0006-claude found. REQ-001 rests on the NL's 'Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks': the sentence conditions the search on a mission-completed notion the model declares no state for, so the release condition cannot be stated.
